quotes.quote: Our findings suggest that loss of functional integrity of the hippocampal-based memory systems is directly related to alterations of neural activity in parietal regions seen over the course of MCI and AD.
quotes.reason: This quote highlights a key conclusion relevant to the understanding of neural activity patterns in Alzheimer's.

quotes.quote: Our study provides new evidence that there is disrupted organization of functional brain networks in AD.
quotes.reason: This quote succinctly summarizes the main conclusion of the paper.

quotes.quote: The accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) plays a significant role in patient care...
quotes.reason: This quote captures the importance of early diagnosis and the paper's context.

quotes.quote: LSN analysis revealed that interconnectivity patterns of brain regions can be used to classify subjects with AD.
quotes.reason: Highlights the effectiveness of the presented methodology.

quotes.quote: Several techniques such as Decision Tree, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Gradient Boosting, and Voting classifiers have been employed to identify the best parameters for Alzheimer's disease prediction.
quotes.reason: This quote highlights the various techniques used, showcasing the methodology applied in the study.

quotes.quote: Improved performance for predicting progression to AD dementia (concordance index = 0.864) was obtained when the deep learning-based progression risk was combined with baseline clinical measures.
quotes.reason: This quote illustrates the main outcome of the study and supports its relevance to prediction models.

quotes.quote: With automated methods, age- and sex-adjusted ASL perfusion maps can be used to classify and predict diagnosis of AD, conversion of MCI to AD, stable MCI, and SCD with good to excellent accuracy and AUC values.
quotes.reason: This quote encapsulates the main purpose and significance of the study.
